pricing.notes: GOOGLE CLOUD MARKUP POLICY APPLIED. This app calls a Google API, so its token prices are the platform's standard tier scale (0/8/12/16/20) marked up ~1.8x (rounded to nearest 5): 0->0, 8->15, 12->22, 16->30, 20->35. This is a standing margin/risk buffer for Google-Cloud-backed apps. It is NOT a pass-through of a literal per-call Google Cloud bill: GA4's own Data and Admin API are free of direct per-call charges -- Google meters usage in request quota, not money. Tiers: 0 = onboarding/account plumbing (connect/switch/select/disconnect, alert pause/resume/delete, diagnostics) stays free; 15 = light Admin API list/get or local alert list; 22 = one standard Data API report call or a property-settings/key-event field update; 30 = multi-call/heavier reports and any real create/archive/delete mutation on the user's live GA4 property; 35 = heaviest calls (batch_run_reports, export_report_csv). See docs/google-cloud-pricing-markup-policy.md for the full standing rule applied to every Google-Cloud-backed Imperal app.
